tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade forestry examinations

steps.what: Select actual forestry and conservation examination items and verify outcomes, answer keys and the marking rubric
outputs: checked examination selection and marking specification

steps.what: Assemble the selected questions, instructions and marking specification into the exact examination version
inputs: checked examination selection and marking specification

steps.what: Review the exact assembled examination under the course's actual designated-examiner release authority
inputs: checked examination selection and marking specification

steps.what: Release the exact authorized examination to the specified student group at the approved time
Administer the actual examination and handle student questions and actual examination irregularities
outputs: actual examination responses and administration context

steps.what: Apply the exact answer key to the actual closed-question responses and total the specified points
inputs: actual examination responses and administration context
checked examination selection and marking specification

steps.what: Grade actual open forestry and conservation answers against the rubric, check closed marks and prepare the complete proposed result list
inputs: actual examination responses and administration context
checked examination selection and marking specification

steps.what: Determine and authorize the exact complete result list under the actual designated-examiner authority
inputs: actual examination responses and administration context
outputs: exact authorized result list and destination mapping

steps.what: Import the exact authorized examination results into the separate student registry
inputs: exact authorized result list and destination mapping
outputs: registered examination results and import status

steps.what: Retain the ordinary existing working grading record in the same learning workspace
inputs: registered examination results and import status

tasks.design: Configure item-bank assembly and fixed answer-key marking in {LMS}. Keep actual examination administration and open-answer grading human, then transfer the designated examiner's exact authorized results to {OTHER}, the separate student registry, through a mapped import.
tasks.previous_blocker: Examination assembly, fixed-key marking and separate-registry re-entry can repeat manual work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item banks and explicit result mappings can perform these defined operations without judging open answers.
tasks.still_hard: Forestry reasoning, ambiguous answers and actual examination irregularities need an examiner's judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands the student's demonstrated reasoning and the examination context.

ambition.what: Review more useful item-level evidence after actual result checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: item banks, fixed-key marking and explicit learning-system-to-registry mappings can remove repeated examination administration work while open grading and result authority remain human.

assumptions: This is the actual teaching arrangement where the focal teacher compiles/administers/marks and an existing designated examiner has release/result authority. s3 and s8 represent that real allocated authority only, not new supervisor reviews or author approval of paperwork. Confirm the actual allocation before using this graph; do not invent another examiner if the teacher holds that role.

s1 counts actual outcome, key and rubric capture. Student responses arise from the actual examination in s5; no free clean response dataset is assumed. s7 retains checks and corrections of generated marks.

Use actual course/student identifiers, examination version, points and result codes; s8 checks the complete destination mapping before import. Any changed examination, cohort or timing voids a1; any changed result or destination voids a2.

Test native assembly, closed marking and registry sync first; existing automatic work earns zero new gain. Registry import applies only where separate re-entry really occurs, not an invented second system. Upkeep includes failed-import reconciliation.
s10 is ordinary same-system working persistence, negligible and fully retained without a gate. Real external notices would need their own final-version send. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
research_questions: Which assembly, closed marking and registry-transfer actions remain manual in this actual course?

already_counted.description: Item/key selection, actual administration, open-answer marking and full mark checks remain counted.
Existing designated-examiner release and result authority remains outside focal labour.

incremental.description: Maintain bank/key and registry mappings and reconcile failed imports.

approvals.approved_version: Exact examination assembled in s2, reviewed in s3 with the actual cohort and release time; any changed version, cohort or timing voids approval.
Complete result list from s7 determined in s8 with exact student/course destinations; any result or mapping change voids authority.

steps.what: Read the actual forestry discussion material and locate the relevant case or passage
inputs: actual forestry or conservation case material

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate and moderate the actual classroom discussion, responding to students' reasoning and participation

tasks.design: Link the actual case passage in {LMS} and {DOCS}. Keep live initiation, facilitation and moderation with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: A case passage can require navigation during discussion preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native passage link can remove that small retrieval action.
tasks.still_hard: Students' reasoning, disagreement and participation require live attention.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides when to probe, clarify or allow discussion to develop.

ambition.what: No automated moderation or student classification.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-passage links can shorten retrieval but do not replace classroom discussion moderation.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual classroom discussion and its immediate source reading. No participation record or class-progress report is invented where none is kept or read.

tasks.short: Plan and revise forestry curricula and materials

steps.what: Evaluate actual course outcomes, student work and the current forestry or conservation content and teaching methods
Plan the actual curriculum changes and select the learning sequence, materials and instruction methods
Revise the actual course content, forestry examples and instructional materials according to the plan

loop.purpose: Suggest revisions to actual instructional material from the teacher's plan
loop.input: Checked revision plan, existing material and supplied forestry source passages
loop.output: Draft revised explanations and instructional examples
loop.check: Teacher checks every scientific claim, source, learning-outcome alignment and suitability in s4
loop.stop: Two drafts then unsupported content is removed and remaining revision stays manual
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed layout handles headings, but revising explanations to fit selected learning goals needs semantic writing

steps.what: Verify the actual revised materials for scientific accuracy, source support, instructional fit and accessibility
Save the ordinary working course revision in the current workspace

tasks.design: Use a bounded revision assistant over the actual plan and supplied sources in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The teacher evaluates the course, chooses the changes and checks every scientific and instructional claim in the working revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material revision requires substantial writing after actual curriculum decisions are made.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded assistant can suggest plan-based revisions without deciding the curriculum or publishing it.
tasks.still_hard: Forestry examples must be scientifically correct and appropriate to the learning sequence.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognizes a plausible explanation that would mislead students.

ambition.what: Prepare additional checked explanations for students with different prior knowledge.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded revision drafting can support actual instructional materials while curriculum choice and scientific verification remain with the teacher.

assumptions: Boundary ends with saved working materials, not formal curriculum adoption or student-facing publication. Actual release needs its real authority after the exact final version and a separate gated action.
s1 counts actual evidence reading and s2 produces the real plan. Actual supplied source selection is counted in that planning work, not treated as a free new evidence pack.
s3 retains23.4 of39 material-revision units and s4 retains10 full verification units. Upkeep includes2 extra manual correction units for failed suggestions.
Test current course templates first; existing formatting and copying earn zero new gain. Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured estimates.

already_counted.description: Course evaluation, curriculum planning, retained material revision and full scientific/instructional verification remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source/layout checks2; manually correct failed revision suggestions2.

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Read the actual student's course history and locate applicable forestry-program, prerequisite and career references
Discuss the actual student's goals and advise on academic, vocational and career choices
Update the actual existing student study plan used at the next advising visit with the student's intended choices
Save the ordinary study-plan update in the same advising system

tasks.design: Link the student's actual course history and current program references in {OTHER}, the student advising system, and {DOCS}. Keep the goals conversation and the real study-plan update with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable prerequisite or program-version page can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course/program links can remove navigation while preserving actual student-context reading.
tasks.still_hard: Career preferences and academic choices depend on the student's actual circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher explores uncertainty and helps the student weigh choices.

ambition.what: No automated admissions, eligibility or course-enrolment decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked course/program references can shorten advising preparation while individual advice remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual advising with an existing study plan read at the next visit. Do not add a plan or contact note to informal advice where nobody keeps or uses one. Intended choices are not formal enrolment or eligibility approval.
s1 counts actual history/reference reading and s2 captures the real student goals; s3 counts the actual plan write. No free structured conversation feed is assumed.

The link removes3 of20 navigation units;17 remain for actual context reading. Existing plan fields already provide a template and no extra writing saving is identified. Test native links first; current support earns zero new gain.

reach: Work with the actual designated examiner and student-registry staff on exact examination versions and result mappings.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who spends less time on repeated examination handling while retaining forestry teaching judgment and actual result authority.
